title: Applied AI Launchpad bootcamp for final-year CSE students
text: AITM is running the Applied AI Launchpad, a live, hands-on bootcamp for final-year CSE students, from 15 to 19 October 2026. The bootcamp aims to take students beyond everyday use of tools like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini so they can design and build custom AI solutions from the ground up, covering RAG, agentic AI and LLMs. The first session has taken place.

title: Aptitude and Soft Skills Training for final-year students
text: AITM held Aptitude and Soft Skills Training for final-year students from 28 September to 4 October 2026. The training aimed to sharpen aptitude, enhance communication and prepare students for professional life.
